kicker: For what you can't explain yet
truth: They meant it for evil. God was already turning it for your good.
accent: God was already turning it for your good.
prayer: Lord, I can't yet see the reason for what broke me, but I believe You're already turning it toward something good I haven't seen. Help me trust the turning before I can see the harvest. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: Ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.

save: Save this before you explain it to anyone
